item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa gsang ba sman gyi sgrub thabs g.yung drung 'khyil ba
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs skor gsum gyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa chen po'i grol phug(phugs) gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa la/ gsang ba sman gyi sgrub thabs g.yung drung zil thig 'di yang / 'chi med gsang 'dus gshen gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyis mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnag pa/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi dmar (smar) byang / mkhas pa de yis gsang ba'i brag la grub pa bsnyes nas/ phyis dus su ban btsun phrag dwogs dbang gi(gis) bon bsnubs nas/ bstan pa rin po che gter du sbas nas/ de dus mkhas pa de nyid kyi byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag rgya bo la mi 'gyur mtshal gyi bka' rtags brda yig gis rgyas btab nas gter du sbas/ man ngag ni stang chen gyi thugs la gab bo/ ces sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'bring / stang chen dmu tsha'i bka' yi pho nya/ rgod rje'i rus thob 7g.yung drung thogs med du 'bod pa bdag la/ mkhyen ldan bla ma'i gsung gis bskul ba dang / dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis yang yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal gshen bstan nor bu gling gi ri khrod du/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa'o/ 'di bris nyes 'gal gyur pa ci mchis pa/ mkhyen ldan bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ mthol bshags bzod gsol 'bul lo bzhes par mdzod/ dam can srung ma'i rko long zhi gyur cig dge tshogs ci mchis ma gyur 'gro la bsngo/ bla med yang dag thar pa'i lam bgrod shog/
